figures_declared.name: fig1_paris_curve.png
figures_declared.caption: da/dN - dK in log-log coordinates: ASTM E647 secant data (50 points), log-log fit (R2 = 0.999998), threshold-modified Paris law, and the ASTM 1e-10 m/cycle threshold criterion.

figures_declared.name: fig2_crack_path.png
figures_declared.caption: Crack path across the C(T) specimen at five cycle stations (a/W = 0.30 -> 0.695) and the a/W - N history.

figures_declared.name: fig3_j_integral.png
figures_declared.caption: K_J on successive contours at a/W = 0.40 (path independence), the three mesh-refinement levels and the ASTM E399 f(a/W) value.

figures_declared.name: fig4_stress_field.png
figures_declared.caption: sigma_yy field of the pin-loaded C(T) specimen at P_max, a/W = 0.40, computed with the quarter-point finite-element model.
